Combined with extreme recursionlimit and heavy identifier obfuscation, this is a classic obfuscated dropper/runtime unpacker pattern used to hide potentially malicious behavior — therefore treated as malicious.

This module downloads an encrypted payload from a remote URL, derives an AES-256 key from an environment variable, decrypts and base64-decodes the result, then executes it inside a vm context (vm.Script.runInContext). The code uses obfuscated identifiers and a GitHub "payload.enc" URL — behavior consistent with a remote loader/C2 stage that fetches and runs arbitrary code at runtime. That pattern (remote encrypted payload + dynamic eval) is high-risk and typically malicious.
